name: Label elements
help_text: What this channel's label carries, top to bottom in position order. Barcode is the symbol plus the code printed under its own bars — every label needs exactly one. Title is the product name, wrapped to its line count. Text is a fixed line, such as the item condition Amazon requires at the bottom of an FBA label. Stacked text sits beside the bars, one character per line, and ignores position — that is Takealot's "MP".
